changelog: Raised the numeric bands for medium/low safety to reduce blanket near-zero demotions of commonly-defensible candidates so they can survive realistic budgets.
Adjusted descriptions in each score band to match the new numeric ranges while preserving the original anchor logic (complete clauses → high scores; prepositions/complementizers → lower scores).
Updated 'Additional surface-based guidance' references inside [Priority Rules] so examples point to the new score bands; did not add new prohibitions or repeat [Output Rules].
